anchor_quote:
Table~\ref{tab:p01-w02-p01-024-parts12} collects the notation of the first
two parts in two groups.  The first group contains every registry row of
global scope and every registry row whose recorded scope opens in Part~1 or
Part~2, whatever its role: the connectives, quantifiers, turnstiles,
consequence and satisfaction relations and metavariables registered for
these parts, including the metalinguistic operator names \(\mathrm{NAND}\)
and \(\mathrm{NOR}\) of the propositional syntax chapter, the
effective-calculus metavariable \(\mathsf D\), the literal metavariables of
the syllogistic proof annex, and the assertion and rejection signs of the
classical rejection construction.  The second group contains the
conventions stated or used in the text of Parts~1 and~2 that have no
registry row of their own; they are recorded with the symbol entries of
this chapter and carry the scope recorded there.  They are: the term
metavariable \(u\), which the first-order syntax chapter adds to the global
pair \(r,t\); the propositional and first-order formula metavariables
\(\alpha,\beta,\gamma\) and \(A,B\) of the passages listed in
\cref{def:p01-w02-p01-024-type-metavariables} and of the classical
rejection construction and the first-order Hilbert adequacy section; the
negated turnstile \(\Gamma\nvdash_{S}\varphi\); the ordinal and cardinal
letters of Part~1; and the binary connective symbols \(\operatorname{NAND}\)
and \(\operatorname{NOR}\) of \cref{sec:p01-w02-p01-024-post}, which in that
section are connectives of the formula sets studied there and not the
eliminable operator names of the first group.
